about_the_game:
A short game about the importance of accessibility.

This game explores the impact of accessibility settings through a short, playable experience, forcing players to confront exactly how it feels... to play an unplayable game.

Aggressively human.

Proudly made over the course of 120+ hours of human effort, this game contains NO generative AI output, and AI was not used in any capacity during the game's construction.

This is my first solo game, and that's important to me. I made it, I made uncountable decisions to bring it into existence, and so I documented it...

...with over 30 minutes of developer commentary.

~25 tracks, totaling over 30 minutes, spread across the game to give players a very personal second playthrough. Tracks go over the general subject of accessibility in games, the history of this game, and stories from it's development.

(demo does not include developer commentary)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
